summary: This room held two starving hubs-in-waiting (Bring In a Bigger Mind, Making a Palace Citizen — both dense with outbound thinking that nothing points back at), an under-linked pair of newborn citizens (Martin Buber, Martin Heidegger — seed-stage people whose own frontmatter already names the contradictions and mirrors that should exist, just not from the other side), and one true orphan (The Adjacent Affordance, 0 inbound, a well-formed concept that names its own mirror to The Dichotomy of Control and gets nothing back). The dominant pattern across all five: this palace under-reciprocates symmetric links. An entry declares `mirrors`/`contradicts`/`connects-to` outward constantly, but the target rarely declares it back, so "inbound count" undercounts real relational density — most of what I found wasn't invention, it was closing loops the entries had already half-drawn themselves (their own labels told me what the reciprocal link should say). The best find was a genuine cross-target bridge: Buber and Heidegger, both newborn citizens in this same room, are a real, well-documented philosophical contradiction (I-Thou meeting vs. the anonymous "they" of Being-with) that neither entry names, and both are conspicuously absent from Palace Philosophies' own register of the tradition despite fitting it exactly.

walk_results.note: hop1/hop2 checked (Mixture of Experts, Philosopher Visits the Entry, STIGMERGY, The Lens, Deleuze, Dialectic, Excellent Adventure, Confucianism, Merleau-Ponty, Spinoza, etc.) — nothing beyond what's already declared genuinely wants to point here; the domain (adversarial cold-review by a bigger model) is narrow and specific enough that forcing a link from a general philosophy neighbour would be exactly the kind of force the brief warns against. The one real finding here is a retype flag on an existing link, not a new wire (see typed_relations).

Massive outbound, almost no reciprocal inbound — the room's clearest case of an entry that describes its own worked instances without any of them pointing back. Spinoza, Donella Meadows, and John Cage are named in MPC's own body as 'Worked instances'; none of the three link back. Palace Enchantment and Philosopher Visits the Entry are named as MPC's siblings/consumers; neither reciprocates. And the two other targets in this same room, Martin Buber and Martin Heidegger, are textbook products of this exact method (five-beat body, mandatory blindspot, seed-stage newborn citizen, agency_profile) yet don't cite it.

Buber's own frontmatter already names Cooperation Yields Agency, Whitehead, Stoicism, and The Fortress and the Threshold as real relationships (couples-with/mirrors/contradicts/connects-to) — none of the four reciprocate, confirmed by full-file grep, not just a truncated read. Also missing entirely from Palace Philosophies' own register of the tradition, despite every other philosopher in that hub's outbound list having a return link.

Same pattern: Heidegger already declares Merleau-Ponty (mirrors), Spinoza (contradicts), and The Dichotomy of Control (contradicts) as real relationships; none of the three reciprocate (confirmed by full-file grep). Also absent from Palace Philosophies' register. The room's existing inbound=3 checks out exactly against Epictetus, Buckminster Fuller, and Reverb ↔ Space-Time, all of which do already reciprocate — so the gap is real and specific, not a data artifact.

True orphan, 0 inbound, confirmed by grepping all six hop1 neighbours' full files for the entry's own title — none mention it, despite The Adjacent Affordance itself declaring The Dichotomy of Control as its direct 'engineering-register' mirror and Palace as Context Injection System as the literal source of one of its three worked examples (the @import symlink case). Stage (seed) looks stale given the content — see entry_health_flags.

typed_relations.label: the-practice-this-grounds
typed_relations.rationale: Currently typed exemplifies (No Mind Checks Itself → exemplifies → Bring In a Bigger Mind), which per SCHEMA §4 says the source is the concrete instance of the more general target. That's backwards here: No Mind Checks Itself is the general structural principle (three altitudes — systems thinking, cognition, engineering practice); Bring In a Bigger Mind is the one concrete practice. If anything the direction should reverse (Bring In a Bigger Mind → exemplifies → No Mind Checks Itself), or — since Bring In a Bigger Mind's own body frames itself as still a hypothesis being tested against the more general claim — deepens fits better in the direction proposed here (Bring In a Bigger Mind elaborates/operationalizes the general principle, source elaborates, target is ground). Flagging for a human call on which direction is right, not asserting one.
typed_relations.evidence: No Mind Checks Itself frontmatter: target Bring In a Bigger Mind, type exemplifies, label the-practice-this-grounds. SCHEMA §4: 'exemplifies — A is a concrete instance of the more general B.'
